description:
Refactor a Dockerized Nginx proxy setup to use dynamic configuration. 

Currently, the project at `/home/ga/proxy-refactor/` has a hardcoded upstream URL (`http://localhost:8080`) in `nginx/default.conf`, which causes 502 errors because 'localhost' inside the container does not refer to the backend service.

Your goal is to:
1. Rename/move the Nginx config to use the official Nginx image's template feature (files ending in `.template` in `/etc/nginx/templates/`).
2. Modify the config to use the environment variable `${BACKEND_URL}` instead of the hardcoded URL.
3. Update `docker-compose.yml` to mount the template correctly and pass `BACKEND_URL=http://backend:8080` to the proxy service.

Verify that `curl http://localhost` works and returns the backend response.
